questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision, God sent a man in linen through Jerusalem to mark the foreheads of which men?

answers.text: Men groaning over the evil done in the city
Men who brought offerings to the altar
Men who lived closest to the temple

questions.question: In Ezekiel's vision, God told six men with weapons to show pity and spare the unmarked people of Jerusalem. True or false?
When Ezekiel saw judgment come on Jerusalem, he fell facedown and cried out to God. What did he ask?

answers.text: Whether God would destroy everyone left in Israel
Why God had brought him to see Jerusalem
Whether he could warn the city first
